item.title: Russia launches 948 drones at Ukraine in largest attack over 24-hour period
item.summary: Cities across Ukraine were hit, with local officials reporting at least eight people killed and dozens injured.

item.title: Warning oil rise to $150 could trigger global recession
item.summary: Larry Fink says if oil prices stay high for a sustained period it will have "profound implications" for the world economy.

item.title: Israel says it will take control of large buffer zone in southern Lebanon
item.summary: Thousands of displaced Lebanese residents will not be allowed to return home until northern Israel is safe, Israel's defence minister says.

item.title: Pilots killed in LaGuardia plane crash named
item.summary: Investigators released details from the final three minutes of cockpit and tower communications, which showed controllers cleared both the plane and a fire truck to cross the runway.

item.title: BTS comeback concert on Netflix draws 18.4m global viewers
item.summary: The livestreamed show saw the band perform together for the first time since October 2022.

item.title: Journalists at Australia's national broadcaster strike for first time in 20 years
item.summary: Staff have walked out for 24 hours over a pay rise offer that was below inflation.

item.title: Death toll from Colombian military plane crash rises to 69 as search ends
item.summary: The Hercules military transport plane crashed minutes after take-off near Colombia's southern border with Peru.

item.title: Meta told to pay $375m for misleading users over child safety
item.summary: The owner of Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp has been found liable by a court in New Mexico.

item.title: OpenAI ends Disney partnership as it closes Sora video-making app
item.summary: The move comes less two years after the launch of the AI video app sent shockwaves through the media industry.

item.title: Democrats flip Florida state seat that includes Trump's Mar-a-Lago home
item.summary: Emily Gregory’s projected victory comes in a legislative district which a Republican candidate won by 19 percentage points in 2024.
